snippet.title: Farkle | Medieval Tavern Dice Game – Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
In every roll, a chance.

Farkle is a medieval dice game played by candlelight in a quiet tavern. Roll six dice, set aside your scoring combinations, and decide: bank your points… or push your luck and risk losing everything on the next throw.

🎲 Classic Farkle rules – singles, three of a kind up to six of a kind, three pairs and straights
🕯️ An atmospheric candlelit tavern, real-time rendered
🎵 Medieval music and the sound of real wooden dice
🧠 Play against an AI opponent who knows when to push and when to bank

Same dice. New stories.

Built in our own custom engine (Ptero Engine, DirectX 12).

🔗 Play: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5368450/Farkle_Tavern_Dice/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_2026_10
💬 Follow development: https://farkle.pterosoftstudio.com

Music: "Saltarello" – Emilio Villalba, viola de teclas (nyckelharpa)
Sound effects: freesound.org – kollim ("Rolling 4 dice wooden floor"), nooneisreal ("The Fireplace 3")

#indiegame #gaming #pcgaming
